# vector verify

Prove a program meets its spec plan.

## Usage

```text
vector verify <spec.json> <program.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;spec.json&gt;" required>

the spec plan

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="&lt;program.json&gt;" required>

the program to verify

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--json">

print the result as JSON

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--emit" type="&lt;file&gt;">

write the verified program's TypeScript to &lt;file&gt;

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>

## Exit codes

0 when the check passed, 1 when `vector` refused the input, 2 for bad usage or an I/O or tool failure; see [exit codes](../command-line.md#exit-codes).
